arxiv-2402-15787.title: Grid Peeling of Parabolas
arxiv-2402-15787.creator: Günter Rote, Moritz Rüber, Morteza Saghafian
arxiv-2402-15787.description: Abstract Grid peeling is the process of repeatedly removing the convex hull vertices of the grid-points that lie inside a given convex curve. It has been conjectured that, for a more and more refined grid, grid peeling converges to a continuous process, the affine curve-shortening flow , which deforms the curve based on the curvature.

arxiv-2504-14981.title: On feature representations for marmoset vocal communication analysis
arxiv-2504-14981.creator: Eklavya Sarkar, Kaja Wierucka, Alexandra B. Bossard, Judith Burkart, Mathew Magimai.-Doss
arxiv-2504-14981.description: Abstract The acoustic analysis of marmoset ( Callithrix jacchus ) vocalizations is often used to understand the evolutionary origins of human language. Currently, the analysis is largely carried out in a manual or semi-manual manner. Thus, there is a need to develop automatic call analysis methods.

arxiv-2512-20877.title: Architectural Trade-offs in Small Language Models Under Compute Constraints
arxiv-2512-20877.creator: Shivraj Singh Bhatti - ssbhatti@umass.edu
arxiv-2512-20877.description: Abstract We present a systematic empirical study of small language models under strict compute constraints, analyzing how architectural choices and training budget interact to determine performance. Starting from a linear next-token predictor, we progressively introduce nonlinearities, self-attention, and multi-layer transformer architectures, evaluating each on character-level modeling of Tiny Shakespeare and word-level modeling of Penn Treebank (PTB) and WikiText-2.

pmc-11457786.title: Association Between the Aggregate Index of Systemic Inflammation and Clinical Outcomes in Patients with Acute Myocardial Infarction: A Retrospective Study
pmc-11457786.creator: Yan Jiang, Baolin Luo, Wen Lu, Yaqin Chen, Yanchun Peng, Liangwan Chen, Yanjuan Lin
pmc-11457786.description: PurposeThe Aggregate Index of Systemic Inflammation (AISI) has emerged as a novel marker for inflammation and prognosis, but its role in patients with acute myocardial infarction has not been studied. Therefore, this study aimed to investigate the impact of different AISI levels on the clinical outcomes of patients with acute myocardial infarction.

pmc-11533516.title: Production of biodegradable food packaging from mango peel via enzymatic hydrolysis and polyhydroxyalkanoates synthesis: A review on microbial intervention
pmc-11533516.creator: Vinay Kumar Pandey, Zaryab Shafi, Anjali Tripathi, Gurmeet Singh, Rahul Singh, Sarvesh Rustagi
pmc-11533516.description: Highlights•The problems with plastic packaging waste have led to the development of sustainable alternatives.•Polyhydroxyalkanoates (PHAs) are thermoplastic polyesters that are biodegradable and valuable.•The process involves enzymatic hydrolysis, which converts complex carbohydrates into simple sugars using mango peel as a substrate.•The synthesized PHAs is a class of biodegradable polymer suitable for food packaging.

pmc-11713039.title: Loneliness, social isolation in older adults and their association with incident dementia in men and women: 3 years of follow‐up on population‐based study
pmc-11713039.creator: Brenda Sarai Miranda Sánchez, Isaac Acosta‐Castillo, Ana Luisa Sosa
pmc-11713039.description: BackgroundDementia is a syndrome highly prevalent in elderly. Genetic and health factors have been reported to be associated with their onset. There is evidence that some psychosocial factors may have a differential effect by sex, beyond biological or hormonal explanations, as loneliness and social isolation(SI).

pmc-12621768.title: Comparison of single-incision intragastric and conventional multiport laparoscopic wedge resections for endophytic gastric subepithelial tumors: a retrospective single-center cohort study
pmc-12621768.creator: Jin Ah Kwon, Jin Sung Kim, In Kyu Park, Song Soo Yang, Dong Jin Park, Gyu Yeol Kim
pmc-12621768.description: PurposeEndophytic gastric subepithelial tumors (SETs), especially those near the gastroesophageal junction (GEJ), present challenges in localization and resection. This study aimed to compare the outcomes of single-incision intragastric wedge resection (SIWR) and conventional multiport laparoscopic wedge resection (CWR) for endophytic gastric SETs, including a subgroup analysis of tumors located near the GEJ.

pmc-12653527.title: Intravitreal Aflibercept for the Treatment of Diabetic Retinopathy Among Patients Who Completed PANORAMA: 1-Year Outcomes from the VOYAGE Extension Study
pmc-12653527.creator: Avery W. Zhou, Gail M. Teagle, Liisa M. Baumann, Jessica A. Cao, Andres Emanuelli, Allen Y. Hu, Adam S. Berger, James C. Major, Seong Y. Lee, Stephen M. Huddleston, Victor H. pmc-12653527.description: Background/Objectives: Evaluate outcomes and treatment patterns with 2 mg intravitreal aflibercept injection among patients who completed the phase 3 PANORAMA trial and enrolled in the VOYAGE (ClinicalTrials.gov identifier, NCT04708145; 12 January 2021) long-term extension study. pmc-12660420.title: Caregiving Quality Across Development and Secure Base Knowledge among Adolescents with a History of Institutional Care
pmc-12660420.creator: Megan M Hare, Elia Psouni, Katherine L Guyon-Harris, Kathryn L Humphreys, Nathan A Fox, Charles A Nelson, Charles H Zeanah
pmc-12660420.description: Secure base scripts are implicit schemas that guide perceptions, responses, and interactions by encapsulating expectations of support from attachment figures during distress. The current study investigated the impact of early institutional rearing and the causal effects of high-quality foster care following early deprivation on secure base scripts in adolescents who had experienced severe early deprivation.

pmc-13191253.title: An open-source spectral measurement platform for plant reflectance and material identification
pmc-13191253.creator: M Mejia-Herrera, JS Botero-Valencia, JF Vargas-Bonilla, JM Pearce
pmc-13191253.description: Spectral sensing plays a crucial role in agriculture, environmental monitoring, and material characterization, providing non-destructive insights into chemical composition and physiological status of plants. Commercial spectrometers, however, are often expensive and lack modularity, which limits their adoption in educational, research and field applications.

pmc-13417209.title: Tunable Thermotropic Liquid Crystals Using Amphiphilic Sequence-Defined Macromolecules
pmc-13417209.creator: Irene De Franceschi, Valentin P. Beyer, Steve Huband, Nezha Badi, Sébastien Perrier, Filip E. Du Prez
pmc-13417209.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Liquid crystals (LCs) are a class of materials that combine molecular order and fluidity, making them crucial for technologies from displays to sensors. However, polymeric LC materials typically lack molecular precision, limiting systematic control over their phase behavior. Here, we report a modular synthetic strategy to prepare amphiphilic columnar liquid crystals based on hydrophobic di- and trialkylated galloyl cores attached to a sequence-defined polar oligomer grown by a thiolactone-based iterative protocol.

pmc-13554085.title: When expertise became just another opinion
pmc-13554085.creator: Marek Marzec
pmc-13554085.description: Scientific knowledge is advancing faster than ever, yet its authority is increasingly detached from the way information circulates in public debates. This article proposes a transparent, professionally curated repository of validated scientific and educational materials as shared infrastructure for science communication.
